data.title: NBA tightens betting rules, develops AI to flag suspicious wagers
data.description: The NBA is tightening restrictions on bets and deploying AI to help identify suspicious wagering, according to two documents obtained by CNBC.
data.author: Jessica Golden,Contessa Brewer
